parts:
Hi D-RUGgies,

We will have a working group tomorrow, 11/07, from 11am-1pm in 360 Shields Library. For the first hour, I will be giving a tutorial on using dplyr commands like group_by, summarize, arrange, count to analyze data in data.frames. I hope to see you soon!

Best,
Taylor

Food Science Graduate Group
Lab for Data Intensive Biology
University of California, Davis
